title: Gizmo in Crystal Ball
description: A glowing glass snow globe sits on a wooden surface, containing a neon-outlined Gizmo from Gremlins standing with arms outstretched. Inside the sphere are vibrant electric lines in yellow, blue, and pink, a large green reptilian eye at the base, and floating mushroom-like shapes. A bright yellow beam of light enters the globe from the left.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal painting of a glowing crystal ball resting on a dark wooden table. Inside the transparent sphere stands Gizmo from Gremlins, outlined in bright neon yellow with large ears and green eyes. A large green reptilian eye with a vertical pupil sits at the base of the globe. Vibrant electric energy lines in yellow, cyan, and magenta swirl around him along with floating pink mushrooms. A powerful yellow beam of light shoots into the globe from the left side. Dark moody background with purple wall and light leak.
